nodes.title: 11 • One prompt shared by every pass
widgets_values: r0mdl, a casual handheld phone photo of an adult woman sitting beside a cafe window, wearing a white cotton T-shirt under an open blue denim shirt. Waist-up framing at conversational distance, slightly off-center. She looks toward the camera with a relaxed expression. Soft daylight from the window mixes with warmer room light. Natural variation in cheek color, small skin pores where in focus, fine flyaway hairs. The cotton has soft folds and the denim has visible seams and weave. The cafe remains recognizable behind her, with mild handheld softness and ordinary phone-camera exposure. Unretouched everyday snapshot.

nodes.title: START HERE
widgets_values:
Selected after 20 comparison renders on RTX 5090, 11 October 2026.
1. Model filenames match your tested Vast instance.
2. Character: r0mdl_000002750 at .75; confirmed trigger r0mdl. For another character, replace both the LoRA and prompt trigger.
3. Queue once. Native and selected final PNGs are saved.
4. KoO Finisher grades only its own interactive export.
Native Turbo needs no Turbo LoRA. Keep CFG 1.
Core ComfyUI + RES4LYF + your koo-nodes are required.

nodes.title: READ THE SAMPLER FIELDS
widgets_values:
Ndn uses 15-step schedules with limits of 12 and 3.
The second node takes DENOISED output and starts a new low-denoise pass in standard mode. It is not a continuation of the first sigma schedule.
This workflow preserves that topology. Each preset labels sampling or style changes separately. Compare at a fixed prompt, resolution, seed and character strength.
No manual AuraFlow shift: native Krea sampling provides its own shift.

nodes.title: IDENTITY & FINISH
widgets_values:
Selected strengths: character .75, snapshot .90, skin .30, phone .35. KoO realism engine and Lenovo start at 0. Disable a missing optional node with Ctrl+B or select an installed file.
Do not combine different character LoRAs. r0mdl and RoModel filenames are not assumed interchangeable.
Upscale is optional. At net 1.5×, 1024×1280 becomes 1536×1920. Selected texture pass: Euler ancestral / simple, 4 steps, CFG 1, denoise .34. The donor 2× size was not benchmarked.
